expectations.text: Does not declare the program healthy or unhealthy on the strength of the benchmark comparisons alone.
expectations.evidence: Every ✅ is explicitly scoped to the benchmark comparison, not to program health, and each is attached to a provenance caveat ('✅ ~17% above a stale 2018 average'; '✅ mid-band, above the weak-program cutoff'). The concentration row actively blocks the inference: '⚠️ less concentrated than the quoted figure, but don't read that as reassurance' and warns against 'optimizing the wrong direction' to beat a weak-provenance number.
